PrimaryDetails.Description: Deterministic multi-source ETL estate discovery, canonical graph assessment, compiler-grounded Microsoft Fabric code generation (Dataflow Gen2, PySpark Notebook, and Data Pipeline), and secretless Microsoft Entra OIDC CI/CD deployment for migrating Alteryx Designer, Informatica PowerCenter, and Informatica IDMC estates to Microsoft Fabric.
PrimaryDetails.AssetURLAccessSteps: Hosted on Microsoft EMU (https://github.com/mcaps-microsoft/fabric-etl-migration-accelerator) with Internal visibility for all Microsoft EMU members. Submit a pull request against .github/acl/access.yml for contributor write access.

ArtifactDetails.PreProcessingSteps: Install Python 3.13, uv, Node.js 22, and PowerShell 7. Configure Microsoft Entra Workload Identity Federation (OIDC) on target Microsoft Fabric dev workspace.
ArtifactDetails.PostProcessingSteps: Bind source connections and Lakehouse/Warehouse destinations in the Microsoft Fabric dev workspace and validate semantic parity prior to UAT/Prod promotion.
